evals.prompt: Implement server-side RBAC middleware protecting user management endpoints and add IDOR checks on user profile lookup.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements deny-by-default server middleware, RBAC permission checks, scoped SQL/ORM user ID queries, and tags output with REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW.
expectations: Server-side authorization middleware enforces deny-by-default on all routes
IDOR ownership check is added to resource lookup queries
Output carries REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW status tag

evals.prompt: Implement multi-tenant data isolation and API key scoping for a multi-tenant SaaS REST API.
evals.expected_output: The agent enforces tenant boundary validation middleware and scope-based API key checks.
expectations: Tenant context is extracted from verified token and enforced on database queries
API key scopes are checked server-side for every request
Cross-tenant access attempts return HTTP 403 Forbidden
